'''Cabuck Junior''', also known just as '''Junior''', was a [[Drezar]] [[Gender|male]] [[Reproduction|born]] around [[135 BBY]]. Their [[parent]] [[Cabuck]] owned the [[Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop]] on the [[Planet|world]] [[Ueda]] and sometimes brought Junior to work with him. In [[132 BBY]], the parent and child were both present at the shop when the [[Sith assassin|assassin]] [[Mae-ho Aniseya]] [[Indara's murder|killed]] [[Jedi Master]] [[Indara]] there.

==Biography==
Cabuck Junior, also known as just Junior, was a [[Drezar]] [[Gender|male]] [[Reproduction|born]]<ref name="Visual Guide" /> around [[135 BBY]]<ref name="Dates" /> to [[Cabuck]], the owner and [[bartender]] of the [[Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop]] in [[Point Ueda]] village on the [[planet]] [[Ueda]],<ref name="Visual Guide" /> who sometimes bought them to work with him.<ref name="Databank">{{Databank|cabuck|Cabuck}}</ref> Junior's [[parent]] was able to use his wide-set [[eye]]s to watch out for his son while also attending to multiple guests.<ref name="Visual Guide" />

[[File:CabuckJuniorScared-LostFound.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Cabuck Junior grips their father's leg tightly and buries their face against it as Cabuck places his hand on the child's head.|Cabuck Junior hid their face from Mae-ho Aniseya.]]
In [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> the [[Sith assassin|assassin]] [[Mae-ho Aniseya]] attacked and [[Indara's murder|killed]] [[Jedi Master]] [[Indara]] in the shop as Cabuck watched from behind the bar. Once the [[Jedi]] was [[Death|dead]], Aniseya approached Cabuck and prepared to throw a [[Mae's knives|knife]] at him, but paused upon hearing the whimpering of Cabuck Junior, who was clutching their parent's [[Limb|leg]]. The child buried their face in Cabuck's leg, and the bartender placed a hand upon Cabuck Junior's head. The [[assassin]] then left without harming either and Cabuck turned to tend to his child.<ref name="Lost Found" />

==Personality and traits==
Cabuck Junior was a shy child<ref name="Visual Guide" /> with brown skin and green eyes.<ref name="Lost Found" />

==Equipment==
During their encounter with Aniseya, Cabuck Junior wore a [[Color|gray]] [[Clothing|shirt]] with matching pants and [[boot]]s as well as a brown satchel and clutched a<ref name="Lost Found" /> handmade<ref name="Beccy Instagram">{{Instagram|username=youngsterbeccy|url=/p/C8r-IbKIyRH/?img_index=2|name=[[Beccy Henderson]]|date=2024-06-26|quote=Fun fact: The Bartenders child is holding a handmade teddy of the Noodle Slurper|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/tBVu5}}</ref> blue toy<ref name="Lost Found" /> of the [[Reshtini]]<ref name="Visual Guide" /> [[Kesmer Faloodi]]<ref name="Beccy Instagram" /> tightly.<ref name="Lost Found" /> They also possessed a [[spinner toy]] made from a repurposed tankage seal.<ref name="Visual Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Design===
{{Quote|That facial anatomy—the wide eyes, the descending eyebrows—wasa very good for setting the scene and showing their fear. He has a blind spot in the middle like a rabbit, which is why when the blade comes toward him, his child is much more shocked than he is. He actually didn't even see it. All these proportions, with his son holding onto the leg, played a part in the design. You're working toward one little vignette that will tell the moment.|Neal Scanlan|<ref name="ArtOf">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Acolyte]]''</ref>}}
[[File:CabuckAndSon-ArtStation.jpg|thumb|right|300px|alt=Concept art of Cabuck and Cabuck Junior showing them with purpler skin and hats.|Costume concept of Cabuck and Cabuck Junior by Sophie Fretwell]]
Cabuck Junior appeared in "[[Lost / Found]],"<ref name="Lost Found" /> the first episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired on [[Disney+]] on [[June 4]], [[2024]].<ref name="Announcement">{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref> The child was designed by<ref name="Facebook">{{Facebook|username=MattDoesFX|url=MattDoesFX/posts/pfbid0pFGMnzJcakRVWeAXCvDZzDNpe7GRa5apbh6vSqPbmny7n5eYiFT2URHQkvK2ZL9El|name=[[Matthew Hart]]|date=2024-06-08|quote=Wow, what a dream come true.Back in 2022, I was invited to join the best creature crew around to work on The Acolyte. I never thought I'd be making Animatronics with the best in the business! I have been welcomed with open arms by the whole crew and am loving this chapter of my career! Creature 1 - I did a tiny bit of work on the 'bulb' on this mask built by Matt Macmurray and was great seeing it in the first scene of the first episode! Creature 2 - I built the child when I first started, working closely with and from the designs of @adyfparish. It was a beautiful puppet. Creature(s)3 - I added a sequencer and puppeteered these autopilot droids, meched by Karl Gallivan and built by the Model makers. Creature 4 - TT-8L-OT - my first mech! Working with @theforge_props to come up with this fun guy. Nice to see it used in the opening scene of episode 2! Bring on the next episode....the Creatures we all built look incredible ❤️|archivedate=2024-08-03|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/qvArm}}</ref> senior animatronic designer<ref name="Lost Found" /> [[Adrian Parish]] who then worked closely with<ref name="Facebook" /> junior animatronic designer<ref name="Lost Found" /> [[Matthew Hart]] to build it.<ref name="Facebook" /> [[Martin Rezard]] designed and sculpted Cabuck Junior's head and hands, sculpting the head in [[Wikipedia:ZBrush|ZBrush]]. [[Brian Best]] then used ZBrush to create a 3D mould that was printed and reinforced in fibreglass before foam was added. The hands were a traditional plasticine sculpt.<ref name="RezardEmail">{{EmailCite|email=File:MartinRezard-AcolyteEmail.png|creator=[[Martin Rezard]]|date=2025-10-05}}</ref>

Creature and Droid FX creative supervisor [[Neal Scanlan]] felt that Cabuck and Cabuck Junior's wide eyes and descending eyebrows helped set up their fear and also created a blind spot for Cabuck in the center of his vision. This meant the bartender would not have even seen the blade thrown at him by Mae-ho Aniseya, meaning Cabuck Junior would have been more frightened by the attack than his father.<ref name="ArtOf" />

===Costume, performance, and name===
{{Quote|His little top is very simple. It folds and crosses over almost like a Jedi shirt|Jennifer Bryan on Cabuck Junior's costume|<ref name="ArtOf" />}}
The character's costume was designed by costume designer [[Jennifer Bryan]] with a concept illustration of it drawn by illustrator [[Sophie Fretwell]]. The illustration showed Cabuck Junior with purple skin and wearing a wide-brimmed [[hat]].<ref name="Artstation">{{ArtStation|username=sophie_fretwell|url=artwork/8Bm5eR|name=[[Sophie Fretwell]]|text=The Acolyte - Crowd costume Illustrations}}</ref> Fretwell also created a version of the image without the hat. Bryan's design for Cabuck Junior's simple outfit borrowed elements from the [[Lars homestead|homestead]] costume of the character [[Luke Skywalker]] in the<ref name="ArtOf" /> [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] as well as the folded and crossed-over element from [[Jedi apparel|Jedi tunics]].<ref name="ArtOf" />

Cabuck Junior was puppeteered by [[Claire Roi Harvey]], [[Lynn Robertson Bruce]], [[Beccy Henderson]], and Parish.<ref name="Puppeteers">{{Instagram|username=claireroiharvey|url=p/C9GIKcpo2PQ|name=[[Claire Roi Harvey]]|date=2024-07-06|quote=This youngling in The Acolyte. Gotta have a place on the grid for them. Dreamy team from design through to performance and another joy to puppeteer with @lynnrb3 @youngsterbeccy & @adyfparish oh and peep the toy…it’s the Noodle Slurper!! 👀 #theacolyte #starwars #starwarscreatures #animatronics|archiveurl=https://archive.is/8pJlg|archivefile=File:ClaireRoiHarvey-CabuckJunior-Instagram.png}}</ref> 
The scenes in the shop were filmed at [[Shinfield Studios]],<ref name="Fantha Part I">{{WebCite|url=https://www.fanthatracks.com/news/the-acolyte-a-journey-to-the-filming-locations-part-1-madeira|text=The Acolyte: A journey to the filming locations Part 1: Madeira|archivedate=20241204220147}}</ref> [[Wikipedia:England|England]].<ref name="Julian Foddy">{{Lucasfilm|url=news/julian-foddy-acolyte|text=''The Acolyte'' Visual Effects Supervisor Julian Foddy}}</ref> The character was first identified in an entry for Cabuck in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]]<ref name="Databank" /> posted by [[July 20]], 2024.<ref name="WookCite">{{WookCite|url=Cabuck?type=revision&diff=13570788&oldid=13570063|text=July 20, 2024 revision of the "Cabuck" article}}</ref>
